name: @chromatika/mwa-reflector
description: MWA (Solana Mobile) reflector — relays bytes between a desktop dapp and a Seeker / Phantom Android / Solflare Android wallet during remote QR pairing. Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects. Implements the spec at https://solana-mobile.github.io/mobile-wallet-adapter/spec/spec.html#reflector-protocol.
